'''Talabaw''' ({{langx|ksw|တၢ်လပီၣ်}}, {{langx|my|တာလပေါ}}, {{IPA|my|tàləbɔ́}}; also transliterated as '''talapaw''', {{literal|great soup}} in [[Karenic languages|Karen]]<ref name="dine">{{Cite web |last=Duwun |title=ကရင်မိသားစုတွေရဲ့ထမင်းဝိုင်းမှာ မပါမဖြစ်တာလပေါဟင်းတစ်ခွက် |url=https://www.duwun.com.mm/article/p-id49930 |access-date=December 27, 2022 |website=Duwun }}</ref>), is a soup that originated in [[Karen people|Karen]] cuisine. It is typically prepared with [[bamboo shoot]]s, [[snakehead (fish)|snakehead fish]] and [[basil|basil leaves]]. A small amount of rice and some shreds of meat or seafood may also be added.<ref name="mmtime">{{Cite news |date=September 11, 2019 |title=Top Ten Kayin things to experience |work=[[The Myanmar Times]] |url=https://www.mmtimes.com/news/top-ten-kayin-things-experience.html?qt-social_plugin=1 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220827185136/https://www.mmtimes.com/news/top-ten-kayin-things-experience.html|archive-date=August 27, 2022 }}</ref><ref name="kyaw">{{Cite web |last=Kyaw |first=Min Ye |date=July 17, 2018 |title=Ethnic recipe: Karen Tarlapaw soup |url=https://www.myanmore.com/2018/07/ethnic-recipe-karen-tarlapaw-soup/ |access-date=December 26, 2022 |website=[[Myanmore Magazine]] |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name="locpass">{{Cite web |title=Traditional Foods of Kayin State, Myanmar |url=https://www.mylocalpassion.com/posts/traditional-foods-of-kayin-state |access-date=December 27, 2022 |website=MyLocal Passion}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=ရာသီစာကရင့်ရိုးရာမျှစ်တာလပေါ့ဟင်း |url=https://www.bnionline.net/mm/news-5895.html |access-date=January 11, 2023 |website=BNI|language=my}}</ref>

The Karen traditionally used the soup to supplement rice, which was not cheaply available to them, consuming a large amount of soup with a small amount of rice in order to conserve the valuable rice.<ref name="dine" /> 

Talabaw is one of the most well-known soups in [[Myanmar]], and widely considered to be the essential dish of [[Karen people|Karen]] cuisine.<ref name="dine" />
